Overview

MSD is undertaking early market engagement through this RFI to better understand current market capability and geographic coverage, explore recommended cleaning service models (input-based, outcome-based, or hybrid), understand best-practice approaches to consumables management and identify risks, opportunities, and innovation relevant to large, multi-site government portfolios.

The information gathered through this RFI will be used to support planning and to help determine future requirements and future procurement approach, if any.
